info.name: Nexachain Investment & Referral API
info.description:
REST API for the MERN investment & referral platform.

1. Run **Auth > Login** (or Register) - the test script stores the JWT in the `token` collection variable.
2. Every private request inherits `Bearer {{token}}`.
3. Cron endpoints use the `x-cron-secret` header (`cronSecret` variable) instead of a user token.

All responses share the envelope `{ success, message, data, meta?, errors? }`.
